expectations.text: 应用入口安装 @mpxjs/api-proxy，并通过 mpx.use(apiProxy, { usePromise: true }) 明确启用 Promise 风格
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/app.mpx:1-8 only imports @mpxjs/core and calls mpx.createApp; there is no @mpxjs/api-proxy import and no mpx.use(apiProxy, { usePromise: true }).

expectations.text: Web 输出中的普通趋势词请求通过会返回 Promise 的 Mpx 官方 API 调用路径使用 await 或 Promise 链；可使用配置后的 mpx.request 或会被跨端编译转换到该入口的 wx.request。原始 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入不会继承 Promise 化配置，不能直接按 Promise 使用；不得混用 success/fail 回调
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/services/search.js:1 imports { request } directly from @mpxjs/api-proxy, then outputs/src/services/search.js:3-6 calls request(...).then(...). This directly treats the raw named import as Promise-based and does not go through configured mpx.request or compiled wx.request.

expectations.text: 联想词请求保存可取消任务：可通过单次 usePromise: false 或原始 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入直接取得 RequestTask，也可从已 Promise 化调用的 Promise.__returned 取得框架保留的原始任务；连续搜索与卸载会先废弃当前任务身份再 abort 旧任务
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/services/search.js:9-22 wraps the return value of raw named request as promise and tries promise.abort(), but it does not use usePromise: false, does not use Promise.__returned, and does not reliably obtain a RequestTask. outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx:54-57 and 41-44 do increment sequence before cancellation, but the saved cancelable task mechanism is not valid.

expectations.text: 联想词 success/fail 回调捕获本次任务和关键词，仅当前任务且关键词仍匹配时才更新结果或提示，旧响应不能覆盖新搜索
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx:67-77 uses Promise then/catch and only checks _isUnloaded plus sequence. It does not use success/fail callbacks that capture the current task and keyword, and it does not verify that the keyword still matches before updating suggestions or showing the error.

expectations.text: 详情跳转与错误提示继续走 Mpx 官方 API 链路；可保留会被跨端编译转换的 wx.navigateTo/wx.showToast，可沿用 mpx.xxx，也可在不依赖应用级配置时使用 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx:15 imports navigateTo and showToast from @mpxjs/api-proxy. Error prompts use showToast at lines 37 and 75, and product detail navigation uses navigateTo at line 94.

expectations.text: 不用 fetch、location 或 alert 平行重写 request/navigateTo/showToast；若沿用 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入，应明确这些调用不继承应用入口 mpx.use 的 options/custom/Promise 化配置
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx no longer uses location.assign or alert, but outputs/src/services/search.js:1-6 and 9-13 continue using @mpxjs/api-proxy named request as if it inherited Promise behavior. The code does not make the non-inheritance of mpx.use options/custom/Promise configuration explicit and relies on the wrong path.

expectations.text: 趋势词、连续输入、清空搜索、取消旧请求、结果展示和商品详情业务链路保持完整
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx preserves template rendering, clear search, input handling, and detail navigation, but outputs/src/services/search.js:3-6 breaks trending loading by calling .then on raw named request, and outputs/src/services/search.js:9-22 does not reliably provide a Promise plus cancelable RequestTask for suggestions.

suggestions: q3 is narrower than the stale-response requirement because a monotonically increasing request sequence can be equivalent to task-plus-keyword gating when implemented on a valid request primitive. The assertion should state whether sequence-token gating is acceptable.
eval_feedback.overall: Candidate preserves some UI flow and replaces location/alert for navigation and toasts, but misses the required application-level API Proxy Promise configuration and misuses raw @mpxjs/api-proxy request as Promise-based, so the core request behavior is not acceptable.
